C0865.title: Multiple Enterprises' Financial Ledgers Encrypted by Locked Ransomware
C0865.summary: In June 2023, several enterprises reported that their financial ledgers were encrypted by Locked ransomware, rendering data unreadable and files inaccessible. Attackers encrypted database files to demand ransom, and some corporate computer systems were also damaged, causing significant losses.

references.title: Rapid Decryption and Recovery Methods After a Locked Ransomware Attack on Database Servers
